head: e5245d08d2fe5c05f67742fd8ec5a67b759ca316

findings.claim: profilesettings.go is an entirely new file (253 lines added, 0 removed between the review base and head) adding handleProfileTest, styleTestTarget and profileTestAnswer, but profilesettings_test.go only exercises handleProfilePage, handleProfileSave and handleProfileStyleSave (TestServer_HandleProfilePage/_HandleProfileSave/_HandleProfileStyleSave) — none of the three profile-test functions have a single test. profileTestAnswer is pure JSON-envelope parsing with three branches (unparseable envelope, result.IsError, success) and is trivially unit-testable without any shell/process boundary, exactly like the sibling pattern already used for config.McpServer stubbing in TestServer_CheckPeekFragment. styleTestTarget also has untested branches: no smine-nightly routine found, routine found with ROUTINE_MODEL override, and a configured ROUTINE_TOKEN label whose file is present vs. missing/empty.
findings.evidence: Re-read profilesettings.go in full (253 lines) and profilesettings_test.go in full (220 lines): grep for profileTestAnswer, styleTestTarget and handleProfileTest across every *_test.go in internal/server turned up only their call sites inside profilesettings.go, bootstrap.go and server.go — no test file references any of the three. git show <base>:internal/server/profilesettings.go fails (path did not exist), confirming the whole file, including these untested functions, is new in this diff.
findings.fix: Add table-driven tests for profileTestAnswer covering the malformed-envelope, is_error and success branches, and for styleTestTarget covering no-routine, ROUTINE_MODEL-override and present/absent ROUTINE_TOKEN-label cases, following the style of TestServer_CheckPeekFragment/TestServer_CheckToken already in the package; the live shell.Run/claude -p call itself can stay untested as a paid-API boundary.

findings.claim: routineSession was rewritten in this diff from a single exact-match lookup (`sessions[filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(root, group))]`) to prefix-matching over two roots (the group worktree and a sibling `<group>-cells/` tree) plus picking the most-recently-active session when several candidates match. internal/server/routines_test.go is itself a brand-new file in this diff, but its only test (TestHandleRoutineDetailRunHistory) covers an unrelated feature (the run-history week-band rendering) — routineSession, and every other handler in this 695-line file (handleRoutineConfigure, handleRoutineParams/validateSmineSetting, handleRoutineTokenAdd, handleRoutineDuplicate, intervalFromForm, reloadRoutine), have zero direct test coverage.
findings.evidence: Re-read routines.go (695 lines) and routines_test.go (37 lines) in full, and diffed routines.go against the base commit: the base version used a single map lookup with no latest-wins logic; the head version loops over every session comparing LastActive. Grepped every *_test.go in internal/server for handleRoutineConfigure, handleRoutineParams, validateSmineSetting, intervalFromForm and handleRoutinesIndex — no hits anywhere, confirming the gap is not covered elsewhere in the package.
findings.fix: Add a routineSession test with cases: a session under the group worktree only, a session under the `<group>-cells/` sibling only, and two simultaneous candidates where the one with the later LastActive must win — the exact behavior this diff introduced and the existing new test file does not touch.

findings.claim: handleWelcomeBootstrapStatus and resolveBootstrapSession (bootstrap.go, both new in this diff) have no test at all; only the lock-conflict branch of the sibling handleWelcomeBootstrap is covered (TestWelcomeBootstrapConcurrent in welcome_test.go). Unlike the paid claude -p call inside handleWelcomeBootstrap, resolveBootstrapSession's logic (matching the newest peek session whose cwd equals the repo root and whose LastActive is at or after startedAt-1min) is pure session-index lookup with no process boundary, and the package already has a ready-made httptest MCP stub for exactly this (newStubPeek in sessions_test.go) that could drive it end-to-end via handleWelcomeBootstrapStatus.
findings.evidence: Re-read bootstrap.go in full (198 lines): resolveBootstrapSession (lines 153-171) and handleWelcomeBootstrapStatus (lines 122-148) only call s.peekClient.SessionIndex, the same client sessions_test.go's newStubPeek already fakes over HTTP. Grepped welcome_test.go and bootstrap_test.go for handleWelcomeBootstrapStatus/resolveBootstrapSession/bootstrap/status — no matches.
findings.fix: Point the server's peekClient at a newStubPeek-style httptest server (as sessions_test.go already does for TestBatchPagePeekLinks) and add a handleWelcomeBootstrapStatus test asserting: pid==0 renders "no bootstrap run yet", and a session whose cwd matches the repo root and LastActive is within the startedAt window is picked over one just outside it.

notes: config.go, hooks.go and permissions.go changed in this diff (config.Load -> config.LoadFragment, one line each) but are not in this lane's files list — they were partitioned to a sibling chunk; config_test.go/hooks_test.go/permissions_test.go/i18n_test.go are listed only as partners (read as context for i18n.go's and the sibling-chunk files' coverage, never scored here). No cross-chunk contract issue suspected from that one-line rename.
